text.p: DeWolfe Cos Inc, a home sales services company, said Friday that, despite a loss it reported for the first quarter, its outlook for the remainder of 1997 "remains positive."
In a statement, the company said it based its outlook on the currently strong economy in New England and what it said was its improving business.
It said consumer confidence in New England and demand for homes were currently at a very high level.
"Our first quarter began slowly, but our business gained strength in the latter weeks, with much improved results in March," said Richard DeWolfe, chairman and chief executive officer.
He added that the percentage of homebuyers who also use the company's other services, such as mortgage financing and insurance, was growing.
